neighbours.label: a word that adds effort or goes further with something ('focus', 'cut another', 'an extra', 'pushes further')
fire: This result lets biologists focus their work on a different protein.
For a fuller skirt, cut another panel of fabric and sew it in.
Children born with the disorder carry an extra finger on one hand.
The latest camera pushes image quality a long way further than its rivals.
For a sturdier shelf, drill another hole and fit an extra bracket.
The grant enables the lab to focus its resources on younger patients.
The new engine pushes fuel economy a step beyond last year's model.
If the soup is thin, stir in an extra spoon of flour.
quiet: This result surprised biologists working on a different protein.
For a plain skirt, buy the panel of fabric and hem it.
Children born with the disorder have small fingers on one hand.
The latest camera has the same image quality as its rivals.
For a simple shelf, use the hole and the old bracket.
The grant came to the lab from a charity for younger patients.
The new engine has the fuel economy of last year's model.
If the soup is thin, serve it with a slice of bread.
